en: Scientist
Things are a bit of a mess in here right now, I know, but...
The next rocket launch is coming up soon! Every one so far has flown safely.
Scientist
A launch has to be perfect. If one part in a hundred fails, the whole rocket fails.
And still we keep at it. Why? Because the dream of space never ends.
Those Team Magma thugs want our Space Center. But nothing that small will stop our launch!
Sailor
I found this on a walk along the beach. I've no use for it, so you have it.
Hoenn has been famous for its meteor showers for as long as anyone can remember.
Team Magma can't be allowed to take the fuel! Oh, and here, take this stone I found on the beach.
With Team Magma about, I don't suppose a walk on the beach is safe any more.
Woman
Some people say Pokémon first came here from space. Could it be true?
Team Aqua ought to deal with Team Magma! But then Team Aqua would get full of themselves, wouldn't they?
Old Man
A great lump of metal bursts through the sky and flies off into space... It boggles the mind!
A great lump of metal flying off into space... and Team Magma wants to spoil that dream of mine!
Well, I won't stand for it!
Steven
{player}, have you read that letter? Team Magma means to take the rocket fuel stored on this island.
I can't think what they want it for, but they mustn't have it. I'll keep watch here a while longer.
Why don't you have a look around the town in the meantime?
It's a letter... A notice that something is to be stolen?
'To the staff of the Space Center. We hope you are well. We are very well.'
'We will soon come to take your rocket fuel. Please do not try to stop us. We will take it all the same.'
'More land for everyone! Team Magma'
